title: THE WHAT IS NEW CARD NAMES THE HOLD KEYS
why: The card was stamped v25.69 and the stamp may not trail the build by more than 0.15. The card was stamped v25.69 and every ship stops when it falls 0.16 behind. Its new line names the builds since: hold H plate, hold Alt raid status, middle mouse ping, crouch quiet walk (his key answers 2026-10-13) and no spoken announcer (his order).
now: The what is new card names the hold keys.
